entities.name: Time of Troubles
entities.description: Upheaval in the city of Kush in 4068 AR, marked by Garth's return and the collapse of the brutal regime controlling the city.

entities.name: Kush
entities.description: A city where bloodsport reigns; rebuilt as Estark three years after the upheaval.

entities.name: Garth One-Eye
entities.description: Wizard who returns to Kush, a survivor of the destroyed Fifth House and son of its slain leader.

entities.name: Zarel Ewine
entities.description: Grand Master of the Arena, who wields immense power and keeps the populace and the Four Houses in check.

entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: Former Grand Master who destroyed the Fifth House of Oor-tael and became a Planeswalker, returning annually to take tribute of mana and kill the victor.

entities.name: Hammen
entities.description: An old thief who led a brotherhood of pickpockets and was once a loyal servant of Garth's father.

entities.name: Norreen
entities.description: A Benalish warrior seeking to prove herself and escape her homeland's caste system; Garth's ally.

entities.name: Varena
entities.description: A respected fighter who shared a brief romance with Garth and was forced to fight him to the death.

entities.name: Naru
entities.description: A massive but simple-minded fighter, ally of Hammen and Norreen.

entities.name: The Four Houses
entities.description: The four houses of Kush, which compete in the Festival of the Arena.

entities.name: House of Oor-tael
entities.description: The Fifth House, destroyed by Kuthuman.

entities.name: Festival of the Arena
entities.description: Annual festival originally a test of skill between the Houses, turned into a bloodbath.

entities.name: The Arena
entities.description: The arena of Kush where gladiatorial combat takes place.

events.summary: Garth arrives in Kush and is drawn into its culture of magical duels, allying with the old thief Hammen and earning the name One-Eye in a public duel.
events.quote: Through a public magical duel, Garth earned the moniker "One-Eye"

events.summary: Garth aids the Benalish warrior Norreen and earns her reluctant gratitude, then stirs unrest by shifting allegiances among the Houses.

events.quote: Captured by Grand Master Zarel, Garth was subjected to torture to extract his motives.

events.summary: Hammen, Norreen and Varena free Garth.
events.quote: he was freed by Hammen, Norreen, and Varena

events.summary: Garth reveals he is a survivor of the destroyed Fifth House and the son of its slain leader, and enters the Arena under the lost House's banner, sparking chaos.
events.quote: He soon revealed his true origins: he was a survivor of the destroyed Fifth House, the son of its slain leader.

events.summary: Zarel and Kuthuman declare the final Festival battles deathmatches to ensure Garth's demise.
events.quote: The final battles of the Festival were declared deathmatches by Zarel and Kuthuman to ensure Garth's demise

events.summary: Garth is forced to kill Varena in a duel because her warrior's honor bound her to fight to the death.
events.quote: Garth was forced to kill Varena in a duel

events.summary: Garth wins the tournament; Kuthuman whisks him away and tries to kill him, but Garth wounds the Planeswalker and escapes.
events.quote: Garth turned the tables, wounding the Planeswalker and escaping his clutches.

events.summary: The city erupts in open rebellion; the Four Houses turn against Zarel and are decimated.
events.quote: The Four Houses, emboldened by Garth’s defiance, turned against Zarel, but were decimated in the conflict.

events.summary: Garth returns and drives a dagger into Zarel's heart, ending his tyranny.
events.quote: ultimately driving a dagger into his heart, ending his tyranny

events.summary: Norreen embraces Garth and both vanish, drawn away by Kuthuman.
events.quote: Norreen embraced Garth — only for the two of them to vanish, drawn away once more by Kuthuman.

events.summary: Three years later the city is rebuilt as Estark, with Hammen and Naru as Masters of their Houses and the resurrected Varena as Grand Master.
events.quote: the resurrected Varena had been named the new Grand Master

events.summary: Norreen and Garth reappear, having defeated Kuthuman and sealed his portal, then retire to raise their child.
events.quote: having defeated Kuthuman and sealed his portal, ensuring he could never return

events.summary: Garth reveals his identity as Galin of Oor-tael and, after Kuthuman planeswalks with him, challenges him and steals the power to ignite his own spark.
events.quote: Garth challenges him, stealing the power to ignite his own spark.

relations.quote: after the former Grand Master Kuthuman had destroyed the Fifth House of Oor-tael
